blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The NCAA has rescheduled the suspended San Beda-Jose Rizal University game for Saturday, September 26, in the Season 102 men’s basketball tournament. The Red Lions-Heavy Bombers clash will tip off at 3 p.m. at Filoil Arena in San Juan, the league’s management committee announced. Saturday’s game will be the only NCAA fixture that day, as the league normally holds games on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays. “Again, we apologize for any inconvenience caused by the cancellation. Thank you for your patience, understanding, and continued support,” said the NCAA. The first game of the double header last Friday was suspended due […]...
